name: Nikhilesh Mishra/ ନିଖିଳେଶ ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nikhilesh Mishra writes poetry in Odia and English, alongside short fiction, translation and screenwriting. His collections include Kehi Jane Kejani Kouthi, Kabitie Marigala Pare and Someone Somewhere. His movement between languages and forms offers several ways of listening to the world and shaping an experience into words.

In ‘ଜୀବନ ଯେମିତି’, life becomes a search for a rhythm of one's own. Tides, changing seasons, birds and fallen flowers offer patterns that cannot quite settle within the speaker. The poem finally turns that private search outward: a discovered rhythm might comfort a lost bird or travel with the wind, rather than return as an answer to its seeker.
